title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 214 (Agent’s duty to communicate with principal)

content.overview: It is the duty of an agent, in cases of difficulty, to use all reasonable diligence in communicating with his principal, and in seeking to obtain his instructions.
content.glance: In cases of difficulty, agent must use reasonable diligence to communicate with principal and seek instructions.
content.study: It is the duty of an agent, in cases of difficulty, to use all reasonable diligence in communicating with his principal, and in seeking to obtain his instructions. This is the statutory rule under Section 214 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872. Apply the elements stated in the text; do not extend beyond the provision. Read with neighbouring Agency sections as applicable. Status remains review / SOURCE_CHECK_REQUIRED pending authoritative verification.
